title: Visuo-Tactile World Models
author: Carolina Higuera, Sergio Arnaud, Byron Boots, Mustafa Mukadam, Franziska Meier
summary: The paper presents Visuo-Tactile World Models (VT-WM) that combine vision and touch to better understand robot contact tasks. VT-WM improves accuracy in predicting object behavior and physical laws during manipulation. It also boosts robot success rates in complex tasks and adapts well to new challenges with few demonstrations.
